fault_semantics.get: Return flags bit 0 as the current boolean fault state; deny globally valid faults outside the exact M7 permission set; return NOT_FOUND outside IDs 0..88.
fault_semantics.set: Use flags[1:0] != 0 as asserted/set and flags[1:0] == 0 as clear, matching the pinned NXP implementation.
fault_semantics.clear_notification: A successful subscribed clear emits FUSA_FAULT_EVENT with state flag 0.
fault_semantics.recovery_notification: A subscribed deterministic recovery/set input emits FUSA_FAULT_EVENT with state flag 1.
fault_semantics.group_notify: Apply a 32-fault window, permission-filter requested bits, and return the effective enabled mask. A mixed permitted/unpermitted request succeeds when at least one permitted fault is updated.

priority_transport.queue_payload: message ID plus ordered payload words
priority_transport.busy_channel_policy: Preserve mixed state/fault event order and dispatch the next event only after the agent marks SMT channel 2 free.

feenv_state_trigger.layout: Bits[7:0] F-EENV state; Bits[15:8] MSEL mode.

fault_trigger.layout: Bits[7:0] fault ID; Bit[8] resulting state/event flag.

deterministic_evidence_inputs.classification: Test instrumentation only; not an i.MX952 production register or physical fault source.

qualification_boundary: This contract proves deterministic functional M7 FuSa state and source-permitted fault command behavior plus ordered priority P2A delivery.
The global 89-fault inventory is preserved while mutation, get and notification configuration are restricted to the exact five M7-permitted faults.
The deterministic triggers are test instrumentation and do not claim FCCU, safety-island or physical fault-source generation.
Physical fault detection, escalation, recovery outcomes, reset reactions, MU/NVIC latency, queue timing, safety reaction timing and propagation remain hardware-correlation gates.
